items.label: M3.4 · Brentwood area
items.text: M3.36 earthquake 9 km SW of Brentwood, CA (~66 km from Campbell; USGS ~227 felt reports) at ~12:25 AM PT Sep 12 (USGS nc75434122). Not a Campbell epicenter — East Bay / Delta edge. USGS: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/nc75434122

items.label: SR-17 NB · Hamilton Ave
items.text: No-injury traffic collision on NB SR-17 just south of the Hamilton Ave offramp (NB SR-17 JSO Hamilton Ave Ofr), San Jose / Campbell (~12:55 PM PT; CHP 1357 / CAD 260911GG1357). Dark grey Tesla Model Y; white GMC Sierra + boat trailer continued. Possible #4 lane. Later neg 1125. Affects Union Ave / Hamilton / NB 17.

items.label: SR-85 NB · SR-87 N
items.text: Traffic hazard NB SR-85 at the SR-87 North connector, San Jose — blocking general-purpose lane (~1:11 PM PT; CHP 1339 / CAD 260912GG1339). CHP on scene ~1:27; cleared off live board by ~1:48 PM PT.

items.label: SR-17 SB · Lark Ave
items.text: Unknown-injury traffic collision on SB SR-17 at the Lark Ave on-ramp, San Jose / Los Gatos (~12:04 PM PT; CHP 1149 / CAD 260912GG1149; 1183). Auto crash notification ~12:05. Brief on GGCC/CommuteDash then cleared by ~12:22 PM PT.

items.label: I-880 SB · SR-17
items.text: Brush/vegetation fire with black smoke on SB I-880 just north of SR-17, San Jose (also smoke/flames near the NB 880@280 cloverleaf) (~10:43 AM PT; CHP 0950 / CAD 260912GG0950). Fire transfer; units assigned then cleared ~10:49–10:50 AM PT. Off live GG board by ~11:09 AM PT. ~3.5 km from Union Ave / Campbell.

items.label: I-280 SB · Winchester Blvd

items.label: SR-85 SB · Camden Ave
items.text: No-injury traffic collision SB SR-85 at Camden Ave offramp, San Jose (~12:43 AM PT; CHP 0065 / CAD 260912GG0065). Cleared off live board by morning.

items.label: SR-17 SB · Redwood Estates
items.text: No-/minor-injury traffic collision on SB SR-17 just south of the Redwood Estates onramp (SB SR-17 JSO Redwood Estates Onr), San Jose area (~10:46 AM PT; CHP 1021 / CAD 260911GG1021; FSP 0047 / 260911GGFSP0047; ~37.157490, -121.982095). BLK Ford pickup vs SIL Toyota RAV4; briefly blocked #1 lane; all lanes open ~11:07–11:11 AM; RAV4 tow to Dick’s Automotive. Started 1141 then corrected to 1181/minor-inj COP; FSP 0047 closed; cleared from live GGCC by ~12:13 PM PT. Mountain 17 over-the-hill.
